purpose: Stage 3 validation audit on the 5 LOCKED recipes from Stage 2 walks under D2+D7-Beta architecture. Adds Component 5 (cohort-stratified calibration) per Nasrin's binding requirement on top of existing Components 1+3+4+6 (AUC, ECE, Brier, anchors).

cohort_assignment.method: country-level mean non-null fraction across engineered features in train window
cohort_assignment.consult_attribution: Nasrin Farrokhzad's binding requirement (post-PoC trio 2026-05-03): 'a model that is well-calibrated only on data-rich countries is commercially useless for political risk insurance, where the actual coverage targets are fragile states.'

components_v3_deferred_to_followup.rationale: Component 2 (fragile-state cohort): merged conceptually with Component 5 cohort calibration. Component 7 (structural-break flags): output already in qgi-data/reference/structural-break-audit-2026-05.json (Phase C). Component 8 (SHAP attribution): output already in qgi-data/reference/shap-fingerprint-2026-05.json (Stage 2 Prereq D). Component 9 (BH/FDR vs multi-task baseline): D2 IS the multi-task model -- comparison would be against itself. Defer to Stage 5 post-buyer-disclosure when alternative model classes are explored.

calibration.diagnostic_only: per_recipe_bootstrap_diagnostic — sampling-variability of in-sample ECE; 75th percentile is Ji-Hoon's preferred conservative number for transparency, NOT applied to the F1 0.08 gate

anchor_drift_metrics.policy: REPORTED only, not gated. ADS = mean |drift| across evaluable anchors (PASS/FAIL only); AHR = fraction in-band; AHI = AHR * (1 - ADS) composite. Founder ratification 2026-05-05.

predictive_metrics.purpose: REPORTED-only predictive-power metrics (not gated). auc_pr = Average Precision (rank discrimination on rare-event axis); brier_skill_score = Brier vs base- rate baseline (1=perfect, 0=naive, <0=worse); log_loss = cross-entropy (penalizes confident wrong predictions). Founder ratification 2026-05-05.

recipe_counts.purpose: Per-recipe test-set sample counts. n_pos_test is the F5 rubric HARD GATE input (n_pos < 8 -> recipe excluded from head-class assignment per docs/specs/internal/ops/ml-track/06-modular-architecture.md).
